question: The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) 2023 replaced the Indian Penal Code (IPC) 1860 as the primary statute governing substantive criminal offences in India.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. The BNS 2023 replaced the IPC 1860, and the BNSS 2023 replaced the CrPC 1973, both coming into force on 1 July 2024. Forensic reports must now cite BNS/BNSS, not IPC/CrPC.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. The BNS 2023 came into force on 1 July 2024 and replaced the IPC 1860. The Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) 2023 simultaneously replaced the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC) 1973.
